description: This Java class is a command handler responsible for processing update requests for provisioning categories within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, uses annotations for command type specification, and delegates the update operation to the associated provisioning category write service.

classes.name: UpdateProvisioningCategoryRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles update commands for provisioning categories, marked with @Service and @CommandType annotations, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to update a provisioning category by delegating to the provisioningCategoryWritePlatformService.
